Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Great Honor To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live To The One And Only JASPER JENKINS!

Jasper Smiles Wearily As He Accepts The Award, His Eyes Shining With Pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Certificate And Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A New Branch, A New Reality, Where They Survived.

He Sits Up In Bed, His Eyes Wide With Excitement.

JASPER (V.O)
It Was Just A Theory, But It Stuck With Me. And Now, As I Lie Here, Holding This Record, I Wonder... What If It's True?

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Branching?

Suddenly, Jasper's Face Tenses, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head. He Begins To Shout.

JASPER
I'M NOT DEAD! I'M NOT DEAD! I'M JUST... BRANCHING!

He Leaps Out Of Bed, Pacing Back And Forth Across The Room.

JASPER
I'VE BEEN LIVING IN A DIFFERENT REALITY THIS WHOLE TIME! EVERYTHING I'VE EVER DONE, EVERYTHING I'VE EVER SEEN... IT'S ALL JUST A DIFFERENT BRANCH!

Jasper's Voice Rises To A Frenzy.

JASPER
I'M NOT JUST JASPER JENKINS! I'M JASPER JENKINS, AND I'M JASPER JENKINS, AND I'M JASPER JENKINS... AND I'M JASPER JENKINS, AND I'M JASPER JENKINS...

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild And Unhinged.

JASPER
I'M THE KING OF ALL BRANCHES! I'M THE ONE WHO GETS TO LIVE FOREVER!

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Eyes Filled With A Desperate Longing.

JASPER
But Which Branch Is Real? Which Branch Is True?

The Camera Zooms Out, Showing Jasper's Frantic Form, As The Screen Fades To Black.

FADE OUT.
